finding_classes.population_query: Enumerate every tracked active Owner mandate and structurally parse reviewer-binding markers for R-0007.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Exactly one active structured binding matches the profile; zero, duplicate, conflicting, inactive, substring-only, and fallback bindings fail closed.

finding_classes.population_query: Compare every policy convergence command ID with each cold convergence pass result.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Both cold passes execute every authoritative policy command at stable exact-head clean boundaries; pass 2 writes nothing and is semantically equivalent.

finding_classes.population_query: Exercise staged, unstaged, untracked, deleted, renamed, dynamic-load, incomplete-population, and coverage-relevant changes.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Every ambiguous or incomplete change executes full-suite and whole-coverage with explicit reason codes.

finding_classes.population_query: Tamper each freshness identity field and each transitive dependency result while preserving a valid self-digest.
affected_population: every affected-test and policy-gate cache record
finding_classes.repair_condition: Reuse requires exact current identity equality and still-fresh dependency PASS proofs; any mismatch executes the complete dependent population.

finding_classes.population_query: Census all seven authoritative topic source classes and verify the pre-existing exact-candidate manifest.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Scope generation fails without an authentic exact-candidate manifest and emits every source class atomically without round-specific fabricated topics.

finding_classes.population_query: Mutate JSONL record order, duplicate headers or terminals, append trailing records, orphan findings, and attempt prohibited reuse.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Only one header-first and one terminal-last stream with exact topic and finding linkage passes; obligation reuse policy is enforced.

finding_classes.population_query: Attempt every undeclared state transition, same-candidate cycle 2, stale PASS reuse, cycle 3, and cross-identity transport retry.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Only declared identity-bound transitions pass; cycle 2 requires a distinct regenerated candidate and cycle-1 complete-class repair evidence.

finding_classes.population_query: Recompute every materialized claim producer, extractor, source manifest, value, digest, and rendered location.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Any producer, source, extracted-value, value-digest, or rendered-location mismatch fails claims-check.

finding_classes.population_query: Parse every tracked Owner mandate and census only complete reviewer-binding markers whose mandate ID and active status agree with the containing mandate.
affected_population: zero, one, duplicate, conflicting, inactive, ambiguous, and fallback-capable complete bindings
finding_classes.repair_condition: General mandate prose never becomes a binding; exactly one complete schema-valid active binding matching the profile passes and every other population fails closed.

finding_classes.population_query: Delete, truncate, stale, partially populate, tamper, substitute, and cross-digest-mismatch candidate and convergence evidence across every identity, gate, pass, and digest field.
affected_population: candidate manifest required convergence and candidate-identity digests
two independently authenticated complete equivalent convergence passes
atomic review-scope generation without fallback evidence
finding_classes.repair_condition: Only exact cross-bound candidate and convergence records with two complete equivalent passes pass; every malformed, missing, stale, partial, tampered, substituted, or mismatched record fails atomically.

finding_classes.population_query: Duplicate each finding ID in JSON and JSONL, then mutate every reusable topic input, evidence reference, evidence byte, evidence digest, and required freshness task key independently.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Duplicate finding IDs always fail and REUSED_FRESH_PASS requires independent exact recomputation of every current input, evidence, and required nonempty task key.

finding_classes.population_query: Attempt every undeclared, skipped, stale, cross-identity, forged-predecessor, unauthenticated-repair, same-candidate second-run, post-terminal, cycle-3, and exhausted-transport transition.
affected_population: schema and self-digest validation for every linked record
authenticated first failure and complete-class repair evidence
finding_classes.repair_condition: Only the complete authenticated declared chain passes; review 2 binds the exact prior failure and distinct regenerated candidate, and terminal states reject every successor.

finding_classes.population_query: Mutate or omit every producer, source-manifest, output, extracted-value, canonical digest, structured rendered marker, rendered content, and per-location verification field independently.
affected_population: runtime materialized claim ledger distinct from declaration registry
every proof field for every claim
finding_classes.repair_condition: claims-check reads runtime materialization and independently recomputes every field and exact marker at every location; any omission, placeholder, substring-only match, or mismatch fails the ledger.
